definitions.explanation: Something that causes mental distress or preoccupation. Personal troubles or difficulties that one struggles with.

examples.japanese: {悩|なや}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦いつでも→いつでも：03826_itsudemo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: If you have any worries, feel free to talk to me anytime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悩|なや}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えている→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}→人間関係：11462_ningenkankei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悩|なや}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: She has a lot of troubles with interpersonal relationships.

notes:
{悩|なや}み is the noun for a personal worry or problem — something one keeps turning over in one's mind. It is countable and concrete enough to be 'had,' 'carried,' or 'confided': the thing itself, not the state of worrying (that is ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悩|なや}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have worries)
- {悩|なや}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ (to carry/have worries)
- {悩|なや}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to consult about one's worries)
- {悩|なや}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける→打ち明ける：04230_uchiakeru⟧ (to confide one's troubles)
- {悩|なや}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧ (source of worry, cause of trouble)

TYPES OF {悩|なや}み:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悩|なや}み (work troubles)
- ⟦{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}→人間関係：11462_ningenkankei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悩|なや}み (relationship troubles)
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悩|なや}み (health concerns)
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{悩|なや}み (a luxury problem, first-world problem)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ (to worry, to be troubled — the verb this noun comes from)
- ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧ (worry, anxiety — directed at a specific outcome, often on someone else's behalf)
- ⟦{苦悩|くのう}→苦悩：05517_kunou⟧ (anguish, suffering — far more intense, and literary)
